title: Cross-codec EED bounds, output integrity, and comparator eligibility
mode: Primary-source web research and read-only local source/test crosswalk; plan-only
scope: Refresh current LibreDWG route/version eligibility from project documentation and 0.14.1 NEWS.
Read detailed current LibreDWG and ACadSharp reports for EED size overflow, string output integrity, native acceptance, and ACIS payload loss.
Compare the concrete EED boundary report to local generated size tests and refine the lowest-cost version coverage gap without changing support claims.

sources.revision: Open issue pages reviewed 2026-10-20; mutable issue evidence
sources.observed: #1282 reports a generated LINE whose one-APPID EED is exactly 32,768 encoded bytes; the peer writer serializes stream length through signed short and the report says AC1015, AC1018, and AC1032 output loses the object on read. #1277 reports standalone annotative MLeader context-object damage found by AutoCAD LT 2026 AUDIT after same-library no-op roundtrip. #1297 reports AC1032 native rejection where one MTEXT group-90 value changes the outcome but the suspected object-graph cause is not established. None proves a libdxfrw defect or a normative DWG limit.

sources.revision: Mutable README/NEWS/issues reviewed 2026-10-20; NEWS identifies LibreDWG 0.14.1 dated 2026-07-25
sources.observed: The README says DWG writing works through R2004, dxf2dwg is R2000-only, and dwg2dxf has incomplete broad coverage. NEWS records R2004 DWG writer work and continuing security/fuzz fixes, including decompression/page bounds, EED/XDATA, progress, and 3DSOLID size handling. Milestone wording about 2004-2018 is planning context and conflicts with the documented R2004 limit. #1412 reports C-string output incorporating allocator residue after string rewriting; #1408 reports an unreduced complex CR-bearing text case that corrupts ASCII group framing; #1411 reports an R2013+ AcDs SAB association loss.

localEvidence: DRW_Entity::encodeDwgEed writes EED chunks using unsigned BS lengths and splits only between complete items.

tests/dwg_object_vectors_tests.cpp::testDwgEedSizeBoundaries currently runs the low-level size matrix at AC1021 for 32,767, 32,768, 65,535, and 65,536 encoded bytes; it checks raw chunk lengths, APPID handle, complete-item grouping, and a following-field sentinel, plus indivisible-item refusal and same-buffer retry.

docs/research/dwg-eed-size-boundaries-fast-slice-2026-10-17.json records the prior focused selector and AC1021 full-file 65,536-byte roundtrip passing. This research pass did not rerun them and found no prior evidence for the same exact size at AC1015, AC1018, or AC1032.

src/intern/dxfwriter.h takes std::string_view at DXF string sinks; tests/dxf_fixture_tests.cpp and tests/wave1_tests.cpp contain generated newline/framing, refusal, rollback, and following-record controls. These are source/test observations, not a universal transformed-string semantic proof.

Existing plan gates already separate output syntax/closure, object identity and owner graph, standalone annotation objects, ACIS carrier association, independent strict parsing, native AUDIT, and geometry semantics.

existingSubplansRefined: PAR-58/7K: widen the existing fast EED size selector with a 32,768 encoded-byte positive case at AC1015, AC1018, AC1021, and AC1032; use version-specific encoded-byte generation and raw envelope/sentinel assertions.
PAR-06/PAR-07/PAR-14: maintain length-aware DXF output, explicit artifact/framing validation, and separation between peer issue patterns and local defects.
PAR-07/S8 and composed native/semantic gates: retain independent object-graph, ACIS carrier, strict-reader, native AUDIT, and geometry-meaning evidence layers.

planChanges: Record ACadSharp #1282's exact 32,768-byte APPID case and contrast its signed-short failure with the local unsigned-BS EED envelope; treat the peer threshold as a bug shape, not a file-format limit.

Refine the same fast EED selector to exercise a version-specific 32,768 encoded-byte case at AC1015, AC1018, AC1021, and AC1032 while retaining the existing AC1021 65,535/65,536 boundary and refusal tests.

Refresh LibreDWG eligibility from its current README/NEWS: DWG writing through documented R2004, dxf2dwg R2000-only, and exact pinned revision/direction required for any comparison; do not infer support from milestone text or aggregate entity counts.

Keep LibreDWG #1412/#1408 as string-length/framing discovery leads; preserve current length-aware sinks and add no duplicate control-character test unless the route changes or a local reproduction establishes a gap.
Reaffirm that same-library readback, strict syntax, object-graph closure, native AUDIT, ACIS payload bytes, and geometric semantics are separate evidence layers for #1277/#1297/#1411.

Keep per-slice validation to the touched strict target, focused selector, existing CTest, and scoped diff check; reserve full suite, fuzz/sanitizer, peer builds, and native qualification for existing composed checkpoints.
limitations: Peer issue pages and default-branch documentation are mutable; no immutable peer source tree/package was pinned or built.
ACadSharp #1282 is an issue-reported sample/control; it was not independently executed, and the peer's signed-short limit is not a DWG specification rule.
The local size matrix is currently AC1021-focused; the recommended cross-version selector refinement is planned but not implemented or tested in this pass.
LibreDWG NEWS and README are project self-documentation, not native acceptance evidence; issue reports do not prove current default-branch behavior.
No test, benchmark, external drawing, peer binary, sanitizer, native application, or geometry kernel was run.
